description: A knowledge base's committed identity (`project.name` and `site.domain` in its .semiont/config.yaml), as a service's document names the knowledge base it serves. Its telemetry names it by its DID (`semiont.kb`, specs/src/service-telemetry/telemetry.json).

name.description: Its name. The gateway publishes it as its resource metadata's `resource_name`.

domain.description: Its did:web domain: its permanent identity, the source of the audience its tokens must carry, and the authority its people and agents are named under.
